extracted.name: Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad
extracted.description: This Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad is packed with juicy grilled chicken, croutons, parmesan cheese, and fresh veggies, all coated in a rich Caesar dressing! Whether you're meal prepping for the week or feeding a crowd at your next BBQ, this cold pasta salad comes together in just 30 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts (, grilled)
instruction_lines: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain water and set aside to cool.
Chop the grilled chicken breasts into small chunks.
In a large bowl toss together chicken, cooked penne pasta, lettuce, cucumber, carrot, green onion, cherry tomatoes, Parmesan cheese and croutons.
Drizzle with desired amount of Caesar salad dressing and toss to coat.
